descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Începător
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
Adastra is a global IT company, offering premier class services and solutions in the area of Information Management. We work in international teams and on projects for leading global financial, automotive, telecommunications and insurance pioneers. We pride ourselves in accepting the challenge of mastering new technologies with each new task and in empowering our clients in achieving results. What gives us satisfaction is the opportunity to apply innovation in our jobs daily, inclusive of new areas such as Big Data, Artificial Intelligence, Internet of Things, Blockchain, Cloud, Data Monetization and Robotic Process Automation.
 Please note: This position is open to candidates who are currently based in Bucharest, Romania, and have the legal right to work in the country. At this time, we are unable to offer relocation support. 
 We are seeking a hands-on Data Analyst/Business System Analyst with strong SQL skills and a focus on creating detailed Excel-based data mappings to support Data Warehouse and data integration projects. The role is based in Bucharest, Romania; the candidate must be physically located in or near Bucharest and available for occasional onsite visits to the client office. The Data Analyst will work closely with enterprise data architects, data governance, development, QA and business stakeholders to capture source extracts, define transformations, and ensure accurate delivery of reporting and regulatory requirements.
 Responsibilities: 
Create, maintain and own detailed Excel-based data mappings as a priority deliverable (source-to-target mappings, field-level definitions, business rules).
Document source system extract specifications, data transformation specifications, and fine-grained data mappings for internal and external sources.
Capture extract specifications from application owners and external providers; negotiate SLAs for incoming data feeds.
Collaborate with Enterprise Data Architects and Data Governance to define business rules for data conformance and standardize Line-of-Business data into the enterprise financial data model.
Work with business teams to design table structures and feed designs for reporting and analytics.
Define complex transformation rules for regulatory and non-regulatory reporting in partnership with business SMEs.
Apply Data Warehouse concepts including slowly changing dimensions, fact tables, surrogate key strategies and other modeling patterns.
Model tables using tools such as PowerDesigner (or equivalent), and produce clear documentation for development teams.
Perform advanced data discovery and profiling to assess source suitability and identify data quality issues.
Work closely with development, QA and UAT teams to provide detailed sizing and estimates; support test case preparation and UAT execution as needed.
Collaborate with Program/Project Managers to produce realistic timelines and track deliverables.
Participate actively in business requirements gathering workshops and translate requirements into technical specifications.
 Requirements: 
Based in Bucharest, Romania and available for sporadic onsite visits to the client office.
4+ years of Business Analysis experience in technology or data-centric projects (Data Warehouse / Data Integration experience strongly preferred).
Solid SQL skills with the ability to write and optimize queries against large data sets.
Proven ability to create detailed Excel-based data mappings and documentation (priority activity).
Experience working with one or more industries such as retail, pharmaceuticals, telecommunications, finance or insurance (industry experience is meaningful but not strictly limited to finance).
Strong stakeholder management skills with experience aligning technical and business teams.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
Detail-oriented with a strong focus on accuracy and data quality.
Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative discipline (Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, Finance, or equivalent).
 Nice to Have: 
Experience with PowerDesigner or other data modeling tools.
Familiarity with ETL tools (e.g., Informatica, Talend, Azure Data Factory) and data pipeline patterns.
Experience with data governance, metadata management and data quality frameworks.
Exposure to regulatory reporting projects and related transformation rules.
Experience working in Agile/Scrum delivery models.
Fluency in Romanian.
